description: English meeting where the same decision (canceling Wednesday standup) is raised, debated, and re-confirmed three times across the meeting. Tests whether the prompt deduplicates within categories instead of emitting three near-identical decisions.

segments.text: First thing — I think we should cancel the Wednesday standup. It is almost always empty and the Monday one covers everything.
Yeah, agreed. Let us drop Wednesday. Monday standup stays.
Sure, fine by me. So no more Wednesday standup starting next week, right?
Right, starting next week. No Wednesday standup.
Moving on. We need to finalize the Q3 roadmap by end of month. Anyone want to take that?
I can drive the roadmap doc. I will have a draft by next Friday.
Wait, going back to the standup thing — are we really sure dropping Wednesday is the right call? People might miss it.
We just talked about this. Yes, we are dropping it. We can always bring it back if it is a problem.
OK, fair. Wednesday standup is canceled. Final answer.
So just to confirm — Wednesday standup is gone, Monday stays. Yes?
